title: Garlicky Brazilian Turkey Ham Casserole
description: A hearty, garlicky casserole featuring turkey ham and mantecare-emulsify, perfect for a sick day, this low-glycemic-friendly dish is a unique blend of Brazilian flavors, with a crumbly texture that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the diced turkey ham and minced garlic until the ham is lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked turkey ham, manteca, emulsifier, cauliflower rice, low-fat milk, brazilian cheese, and paleo breadcrumbs.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg and set aside.
Add the whisked egg to the bowl with the turkey ham mixture and stir until well combined.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the casserole is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
